name: sidekick
description: Neovim protection for Codex: blocks edits to dirty buffers, refreshes changed buffers, and injects visual selections.

interface.shortDescription: Protect unsaved Neovim buffers from Codex edits.
interface.longDescription: Sidekick connects Codex to Neovim so Codex waits before editing files with unsaved changes, refreshes buffers after external edits, and can attach your visual selection as prompt context.
defaultPrompt: Edit this file while respecting my Neovim buffer
Use my selected Neovim code as context
